$comment: Tier-2 DB-state fixture spec for the `roleplay_templates` repo (Phase-2,
delimiters completed by P4.4u3). One committed file drives BOTH sides of the
differential: the v4 oracle (build-roleplay-templates-fixture.ts +
roleplay-templates-tier2.ts) and the Rust port (quilltap-harness test).
HEADLINE: the discriminated-union `delimiters` column plus the string-or-pair
`narrationDelimiters`. Every element schema key order is the Zod schema field
order, so the Rust port models them with typed serde structs (NOT
serde_json::Value, which would re-sort keys). The corpus exercises every
delimiter kind (wrap string, wrap pair, linePrefix, tagPrefix with and without
tokenPattern), addOns present (materialized from partial input) and absent,
hideDelimiter, and narrationDelimiters both string and pair. It also seeds a
LEGACY kind-less delimiter (via `rawDelimiters`, a post-seed raw UPDATE that
bypasses Zod) and round-trips it through an update, proving the read-side
`kind:'wrap'` backfill (v4 `_update` reads → validates → rewrites every column,
so a kind-less delimiter is upgraded to kind:'wrap' on the next update).
The renderingPatterns array-of-objects + nullable dialogueDetection object are
still exercised (their headline from the original corpus).
SAFETY: testPepperBase64 is a THROWAWAY 32-byte key. NOT the real Friday
pepper; safe to commit.
DETERMINISM: every id and timestamp is pinned, so both sides produce
byte-identical post-op state and the canonical dump needs ZERO normalization.

ops.comment: Every delimiter kind in one create: wrap string, wrap pair, linePrefix, tagPrefix WITH tokenPattern, wrap with partial addOns (materialized), wrap with hideDelimiter, tagPrefix WITHOUT tokenPattern (omitted). narrationDelimiters as a pair.
Minimal user template: EMPTY delimiters + renderingPatterns, NULL dialogueDetection, plain-string narration.

Round-trip the LEGACY kind-less row through update (change only name). v4 _update reads → validates (backfilling kind:'wrap') → rewrites delimiters; the Rust port must reproduce the backfilled bytes even though the patch omits delimiters.
Replace name + the whole delimiters array (a new tagPrefix) + narrationDelimiters (now a string). createdAt preserved, updatedAt pinned.
Change only systemPrompt on the just-created `AllKinds` template (delimiters untouched → rewritten identically via re-parse). updatedAt pinned.
